_doc: Era-aware durability taxonomy for retrospective analyses (retro/retro_tool.py). The five base kinds are timeless. The sixth slot, a disruption-exposed franchise, is era-specific: AI_EXPOSED is only the 2023+ instance of a recurring pattern (a franchise that is cheap BECAUSE the market prices a substitution narrative). A retrospective dated D may use a theme only if D >= live_from AND the analysis cites point-in-time evidence that the market was pricing that theme for that company. Fields under 'hindsight_note' record what we know today; retro_tool never reads them.

base_kinds.DURABLE: franchise / compounder; low risk the business becomes useless
base_kinds.CYCLICAL: good business whose earnings ARE the cycle
base_kinds.STRUCTURAL: secular decline or a live existential threat not covered by a live disruption theme
base_kinds.TURNAROUND: franchise not permanently impaired but earnings currently broken
base_kinds.SPECIAL: deal arbitrage, binary legal/legislative outcome, bond

GENAI.label: AI
GENAI.scope: generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility

pit_evidence.event: OpenAI releases ChatGPT to the public
Reuters: J.P.Morgan says ChatGPT-type models deflate legacy IT-services pricing; global consultancies (Accenture, Deloitte) gain share near term
IBM CEO tells Bloomberg back-office hiring will pause; ~7,800 roles could be replaced by AI over five years
Chegg -48% in a session after saying ChatGPT hurts new-customer growth: first large-cap 'AI loser' repricing

GENAI.hindsight_note: Became the dominant software/IT-services derating narrative in 2025-2026 (live coverage files ACN, ADBE, CRM, NOW, INTU, WKL, SAP, IBM, UBER, GOOGL under AI_EXPOSED).

CLOUD.label: CLOUD
CLOUD.live_from_basis: earliest verified filing in this archive: Accenture's FY2012 10-K names 'cloud-based computing' among 'current areas of significant change' that 'may materially affect the cost and use of technology by our clients' (its FY2008-FY2011 10-Ks mention cloud only as an Accenture offering); the public debate may be older. Replaced an approximate 2013-01-01.
CLOUD.scope: public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing

pit_evidence.event: Accenture FY2012 10-K risk factors: 'cloud-based computing' among 'current areas of significant change' that 'may materially affect the cost and use of technology by our clients'
Amazon discloses AWS as a reporting segment for the first time (profitable, fast-growing)

CLOUD.hindsight_note: IBM, Oracle, HP/HPE, NetApp, Teradata derated 2013-2017; Oracle later re-rated as a cloud beneficiary.

ECOMMERCE.label: AMAZON
ECOMMERCE.scope: e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution

pit_evidence.event: Amazon agrees to buy Whole Foods; grocers and food retailers sell off the same day

ECOMMERCE.hindsight_note: Department stores and mall REITs never recovered; scale omnichannel retailers (WMT, COST, HD, TJX) proved durable.

STREAMING.label: STREAMING
STREAMING.scope: cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles

pit_evidence.event: Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off

STREAMING.hindsight_note: Linear-network owners derated for a decade; cable video moved to STRUCTURAL.

EV.label: EV
EV.scope: battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail

pit_evidence.event: Tesla joins the S&P 500 after a ~700% one-year rerating; legacy autos priced as ICE run-off

EV.hindsight_note: EV adoption slowed in the West after 2023; Chinese competition, not EVs per se, became the auto disruption.

GLP1.label: GLP-1
GLP1.scope: GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices

pit_evidence.event: Novo Nordisk SELECT trial: semaglutide cuts major cardiac events 20%; medtech and snack stocks sell off

GLP1.hindsight_note: The device-side fear (DXCM, RMD, ISRG) faded within a year; the staples-volume debate persisted.

CRYPTO.label: CRYPTO
CRYPTO.scope: crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance

pit_evidence.event: PayPal launches crypto buy/sell for US accounts
Coinbase direct listing at a ~$86B valuation

CRYPTO.hindsight_note: Kept in the registry on purpose: a theme that was live and then fizzled as an incumbent-disruption story. A registry of only the themes that later mattered would itself be hindsight.

ENERGY_TRANSITION.label: TRANSITION
ENERGY_TRANSITION.scope: decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining

pit_evidence.event: ExxonMobil removed from the Dow Jones Industrial Average

ENERGY_TRANSITION.hindsight_note: Kept on purpose: the 2022 energy shock reversed the derating; integrated oils went back to CYCLICAL.

OFFSHORE.label: OFFSHORE
OFFSHORE.live_from_basis: earliest verified filing: Accenture's FY2004 10-K lists 'the use of off-shore resources to provide lower-cost service delivery capabilities by our competitors and our clients' as a risk (absent from the FY2002 and FY2003 10-Ks); the public debate may be older
OFFSHORE.scope: lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing

pit_evidence.event: Accenture FY2004 10-K: competitors' and clients' use of off-shore lower-cost delivery named as a risk
Accenture FY2007 10-K: competitors include off-shore providers 'particularly Indian providers ... often at highly competitive prices'; margin erosion 'if current pricing pressures accelerate'

OFFSHORE.hindsight_note: Western IT-services leaders absorbed the model through their own offshore delivery networks; the theme faded as a derating narrative.
